report: ERP field map for the non-destructive stock import tool
generated_by: static inspection only - no ERP database was opened and no import was executed

steps: Validates: negative purchase_price/sale_price forbidden, negative vat_rate forbidden, empty sku forbidden (services.py:126-133). ZERO prices/VAT are NOT rejected.
Constructs Product(... state=ProductState.DRAFT ...) explicitly, adds it to the session and flushes to obtain the id (services.py:135-148).

Stock is not created by create_product. InventoryService.adjust_stock (services.py:233-276) gets-or-creates StockLevel(product_id, quantity=0) and records an immutable StockMovement; that is the code path this importer uses.
All of the above runs inside @transactional (src/database/transaction.py:5-43): one SessionLocal, commit on success, rollback on exception, close always.
how_products_are_actually_created.activation_is_separate: InventoryService.activate_product (services.py:152-169) is the only Draft->Active transition. This importer never calls it; imported products stay DRAFT so a human can verify them first.
how_products_are_actually_created.deletion_is_forbidden: This importer never calls delete_product (services.py:187-231), never issues DELETE, and never updates an existing Product's name/price/state.

product_state_meanings.Draft: ProductState.DRAFT ('Draft', models.py:13). Default for the model (models.py:49) and HARD-CODED by create_product (services.py:139). Included in mobile/website catalogs but 'active': false (catalog.py:32,43; websync/services.py:60,72), so it is not selectable in the phone invoice picker. Chosen for this import.
product_state_meanings.Active: ProductState.ACTIVE ('Active', models.py:14). Only reachable via activate_product; 'active': true in catalogs and sellable. Not set by this importer.
product_state_meanings.Archived: ProductState.ARCHIVED ('Archived', models.py:15). Products with history must be archived instead of deleted (services.py:171-185,205-214). Excluded from catalogs (catalog.py:32). Not set by this importer.

category_and_brand_resolution.models: Category.name and Brand.name are String(100), unique=True, nullable=False (models.py:27-37). Product.category_id / Product.brand_id are nullable ForeignKey columns (models.py:64-65).
category_and_brand_resolution.resolution: EXACT, case-sensitive match on the name string against category.name / brand.name only. No id, alias, fuzzy match, or creation by the ERP service exists.
category_and_brand_resolution.services_have_no_create_method: InventoryService exposes get_all_brands/get_all_categories (services.py:21-33) but NO create_category/create_brand. The UI product dialog only selects existing ids (src/ui/dialogs/product_dialog.py:95-126). Therefore lookup rows must normally pre-exist.
category_and_brand_resolution.importer_behaviour: dry-run lists every category/brand that would need creating. --apply get-or-creates missing Category/Brand rows by exact name inside the SAME transaction (additive only; never renames or deletes an existing row). This is the only write not performed through InventoryService and is disclosed in the plan.
category_and_brand_resolution.if_omitted: Product.brand_id / category_id may be NULL; catalog.py:44-45 then emits JSON null. This importer always supplies both because the manifest has them.

sale_price.erp: Numeric(12,2), nullable=False, model default Decimal('0.00') (models.py:53); service default Decimal('0.00') (services.py:115); zero is accepted because only negative values are rejected (services.py:126).
sale_price.if_none: Passing None explicitly triggers TypeError at 'sale_price < 0' in the service, or a NOT NULL database error if a Product is constructed directly. NEVER rely on the default.
sale_price.if_zero: Legal for imported stock: catalog.py excludes unpriced products from the phone sales catalog, and POS/invoice surfaces use the effective pinned price. The ERP Inventory and phone Needs pricing screens keep the row visible so staff can enter a pin. Website pricing is unchanged and out of scope.
sale_price.importer_rule: Missing/blank/zero is NEEDS PRICING: stage DRAFT at sale_price=0.00 with no pin. Invalid, negative, non-numeric, >2 decimals, or out-of-range values HARD FAIL. No price is ever invented or inferred.

vat_rate.erp: Numeric(5,2), nullable=False, model default Decimal('20.00') (models.py:55); service default Decimal('20.00') (services.py:116); zero is accepted (services.py:129 checks only '< 0').
vat_rate.if_none: TypeError in the service ('vat_rate < 0') or NOT NULL violation on a direct insert.
vat_rate.if_zero: Accepted by the ERP but wrong for Moroccan 20% VAT; catalog.py:41 publishes '0.00' and tax totals are understated.
vat_rate.importer_rule: Take vat_rate from the optional CSV column. If absent, use the ERP default 20.00 but mark it UNVERIFIED in the plan/audit output. Never invent a per-SKU rate.

price_and_vat_semantics.purchase_price: Numeric(12,2), default 0.00, nullable=False (models.py:52). No source in the manifest; importer uses 0.00. Risk: margin/cost reports will treat these as zero-cost until a human supplies supplier cost.
price_and_vat_semantics.sale_price_website: Numeric(12,2), default 0.00, nullable=False (models.py:54). create_product never sets it. Website export falls back to sale_price when it is 0 (websync/services.py:31-37), so a positive sale_price is sufficient; website price imports overwrite this column, not sale_price.

validation_rules.manifest_skus: non-empty and unique after stripping whitespace; case-sensitive
validation_rules.prices: optional CSV rows; missing/blank/zero is NEEDS PRICING and stages DRAFT at sale_price=0.00 with no pin. Supplied prices must be numeric, positive, <= 2 decimals, within Numeric(12,2). Supplier/cost/pro-forma columns are rejected; no retail price is invented.
validation_rules.csv_skus: non-empty and unique; extra CSV rows are warnings only
validation_rules.dry_run: never imports src.* ERP modules; if a DB file exists it is probed only via sqlite3 mode=ro&immutable=1 (no -wal/-shm side files, fails closed on a non-empty WAL); writes only stock_import/erp_import_plan.json
validation_rules.apply_guard: requires BOTH --i-understand-destructive-risk AND stock_import/APPLY_APPROVED.txt containing exactly APPROVED BY HUMAN; requires an existing DB file; no deletes; one transaction; full rollback on any exception

database_location.note: Importing src.core.paths creates TAJ_FROID data/log/backup/config/temp directories as a side effect; the dry-run deliberately avoids importing it.
